title: RichText drops styles after the first flattened run
evidence: Scenario text__rich_span_style_metrics diverges on frame 0: Flutter 220x36, Incular 220x17. Source at HEAD still lays out the flattened runs with the first run's style.
impact: Child colors, weights, decorations and font sizes are lost, and line metrics and wrapping differ for mixed-size spans.
cause: Flattening keeps styled runs, but both layout paths collapse the run list to its first style.
fix_direction: Shape and paint styled runs in one paragraph with their run ranges preserved, so paragraph metrics come from all runs.
limitations: Glyph color and decoration painting are not checked by the recorder; only size is compared.
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

title: Text editing offsets are API-incompatible with Flutter's UTF-16 units
evidence: Scenario text__editing_selection_offsets diverges on frame 0 for text emoji plus x: Flutter length and selection extent 3 (UTF-16), Incular 5 (UTF-8 bytes). Source at HEAD confirms String::len-based offsets in editing.rs.
impact: Callers porting Flutter selection or composing offsets cannot pass those values directly for non-ASCII text. Native cursor behavior was not verified.
cause: Editing values and ranges are byte offsets into Rust strings.
fix_direction: Either convert UTF-16 offsets to byte offsets at the public boundary and back when reporting values, or document the byte unit at every API and adapter boundary.
limitations: The native host round trip for IME and selection offsets is not verified.
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

title: WidgetSpan children are replaced by plain text during layout
evidence: Scenario text__widget_span_layout diverges on frame 0: Flutter 220x40 with the 40x40 inline child reserved; Incular 220x19. The blue child fill is absent on the Incular side. Source: visitor_placeholder at spans.rs:241-249 is a no-op.
impact: Inline icons and widgets disappear and the line does not reserve their width or height.
cause: Incular keeps only the placeholder identity and size, emits U+FFFC as text, and the RichText conversion drops it to plain text.
fix_direction: Pass inline child identity and measured size through paragraph layout, then compose and paint each child at its placeholder position.
limitations: Only the middle alignment mode is compared. Child paint is confirmed by the frame absence only, not by pixels.
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

title: DefaultTextStyle has no inherited maxLines policy
evidence: Non-equivalent configuration: Flutter DefaultTextStyle(maxLines: 1) against Incular DefaultTextStyle with style only, because Incular cannot express inherited maxLines. Result at HEAD: Flutter 220x17, Incular 220x34.
impact: A subtree cannot set one inherited line cap; each Text needs an explicit cap.
cause: The ambient default text configuration stores only TextStyle.
fix_direction: Add paragraph policy fields to the ambient default text configuration and resolve them when Text omits an explicit value.
limitations: Diagnostic only; not a same-input result. Explicit Text maxLines already matches (text__text_max_lines_ellipsis).
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

title: Text controllers with initial text begin in different selection states
evidence: Scenario text__editable_initial_selection_focus diverges before focus: Flutter selection invalid at -1; Incular valid collapsed caret at 3 for abc. After a tap both place a valid collapsed caret at the end.
impact: Code that reads the controller before focus sees different selection state.
cause: Incular's constructor writes a collapsed caret at the text end rather than an unset selection.
fix_direction: Represent an unset selection separately and normalize it to the text end on focus, or document the constructor difference.
limitations: The painted caret before focus was not compared.
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

title: Edit transforms and on_changed run for programmatic controller updates
evidence: Scenario text__editable_programmatic_controller_update diverges at frame 2: Flutter keeps a1b2 with zero onChanged calls; Incular stores 12 and calls on_changed once. At HEAD set_text calls update, which calls update_committed, which runs edit transforms and then listeners.
impact: Application-driven controller updates are filtered or reported as user edits.
cause: The formatter and change-callback path is attached to the controller, not to user edits.
fix_direction: Run formatters and onChanged only on user edit paths; direct controller value updates should bypass them.
limitations: The Incular twin uses edit_transform rather than FilteringTextInputFormatter, so it checks the transform mechanism rather than the formatter type.
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

title: EditableText long press does not select a word
evidence: Scenario text__editable_long_press_word_selection diverges at 616 ms: Flutter selects 0..5 after holding 600 ms; Incular leaves a collapsed caret at 1. Source at HEAD: text_gestures.rs handles tap counts and drags but has no text-field long-press path.
impact: Touch-and-hold cannot select a word or open the selection toolbar in Incular text fields.
cause: The text-field pointer path has no long-press recognizer.
fix_direction: Connect the EditableText pointer path to a long-press recognizer and select a word or position per platform.
limitations: The harness uses mouse pointer events; touch long-press platform rules were not separately checked.
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

title: Incular paints a caret during non-collapsed selection
evidence: Source re-read at HEAD: content.rs paints selection rects when focused and non-empty, then paints the caret when focused, show_cursor and caret_opacity > 0, with no collapsed-selection check. Flutter's _showBlinkingCursor requires a collapsed selection.
impact: A highlighted range can show a blinking insertion caret at its extent.
cause: The caret paint condition omits the collapsed-selection gate.
fix_direction: Gate caret paint on a collapsed selection and stop blinking while a range is selected.
limitations: The frame recorder cannot capture caret glyphs; no pixel run was made.
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

title: EditableText never applies input formatters
incular_ref: crates/incular-widgets/src/forms.rs:691 (TextInputFormatter trait), :702 (FilteringTextInputFormatter), :778 (LengthLimitingTextInputFormatter); no call site of format_edit_update outside forms.rs
evidence: Scenario text__editable_formatter_length_then_digits: Flutter inputFormatters [LengthLimiting(3), digitsOnly] keep 1 char from a1b2c3d4; Incular EditableText has no formatter parameter and keeps all 8. The reversed order (text__editable_formatter_digits_then_length) gives Flutter 3 and Incular 8. Source: rg for format_edit_update finds only forms.rs definitions.
impact: Digit-only, length-limited and other filtering fields accept any input and report unfiltered values through the EditableText API.
cause: The TextInputFormatter trait exists but is never invoked on the edit path, and EditableText has no inputFormatters builder.
fix_direction: Add inputFormatters to EditableText and apply them in order on user edit paths before the value is committed, keeping them off programmatic controller updates (see text-006).
limitations: The harness drives input with InputEvent::Text on Incular and testTextInput.enterText on Flutter; both replace the whole field value. Formatter ordering with a non-empty field is not checked.
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

title: EditableText reports one extra line of height for maxLines and minLines
evidence: Scenario text__editable_max_lines_sizing (five lines, maxLines 3): Flutter 200x51, Incular 200x67. Scenario text__editable_min_lines_sizing (one line, minLines 2, maxLines 4): Flutter 200x34, Incular 200x50. Both differ by exactly 16 px, so the cause is probably one extra line-height of padding or caret space in the Incular field, not the line count.
impact: Fields with maxLines or minLines are taller than declared, so layouts built around line caps overflow by one line.
cause: Not isolated. The exact 16 px offset suggests a constant extra line in the Incular field's height, which was not traced in this pass.
fix_direction: Trace the Incular EditableText height computation at text.rs:141-145 and remove the extra line so that height equals maxLines (or minLines) times the line height.
limitations: Only the 16 px offset is measured; the source of the offset is not confirmed. Line height is 17 px on both sides.
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

title: Text textHeightBehavior with height multiplier 2 measures 0.06 px shorter
evidence: Scenario text__text_height_behavior_first_ascent (Inter 14, height 2, applyHeightToFirstAscent false): Flutter 19.0, Incular 18.94 px high.
impact: Negligible visually, but the difference is above the 0.01 px frame tolerance and shows the height modifier path rounds differently.
cause: Not isolated; both sides apply the modifier, and the Incular value is not a whole pixel.
fix_direction: Compare the Flutter first-ascent height rule in text_painter with the Incular engine height rounding at engine.rs:221-236.
limitations: One scenario, one font size, one height multiplier.

title: Text has no textScaler parameter
incular_ref: crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/descriptors.rs:575-640 (Text builder has no text_scaler); crates/incular-text/src/spans.rs:287,383 (lower-level text_scaler on RichText/TextSpan)
evidence: Diagnostic scenario text__text_scaler_linear: Flutter Text(textScaler: TextScaler.linear(1.5)) and Incular Text at a 21 px font size match at 2 frames, so layout agrees. The Incular twin states the scaled size because Text cannot take a scaler; the non-equivalent part is the missing API.
impact: A subtree cannot scale Text through a Text-level scaler; apps must pre-multiply font sizes, which bypasses system text scaling for that widget.
cause: The widget-level Text builder does not expose a scaler; only the RichText-level text layer has one.
fix_direction: Expose textScaler on Text and pass it to the existing lower-level scaler.
limitations: Diagnostic configuration, not a same-input result. System text scale (MediaQuery) is not checked.
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

title: Text has no strutStyle parameter
evidence: Source search at HEAD: the Text builder (descriptors.rs:575-640) has no strut method; StrutStyle exists only as a type in crates/incular-text/src/style/text.rs:129. No scenario was written because the Text API cannot express the value.
impact: Fixed line heights from a strut (forceStrutHeight, for example) cannot be applied to Text; line heights follow the text style alone.
cause: The StrutStyle value type is not wired into Text or the paragraph layout path.
fix_direction: Add a strutStyle builder to Text and apply it to paragraph line metrics.
limitations: Source-only finding; the behavior of a strut on line metrics is not compared against Flutter.

title: SelectionArea does not select on long press and has no selection-change callback
incular_ref: crates/incular-widgets/src/selection.rs:162 (SelectionAreaController; geometry listener at :253 only); crates/incular-runtime/src/frame/text_gestures.rs:183-189,209-217 (selectable word selection on the secondary path)
evidence: Scenario text__selection_area_long_press_drag: after a 600 ms touch hold on the first text, Flutter selects the word 'alpha' (length 5) and the drag extends to 15; Incular stays at 0. Flutter fires onSelectionChanged once at 616 ms; Incular has no selection-change callback, so the count is missing (value.selection_changes recorded only for Flutter). Column placement was aligned to start on both sides after a twin fix.
impact: Touch users cannot select text in a SelectionArea, and apps cannot observe selection changes through this API.
cause: Long-press selection is not connected to selectable text; the selection controller exposes geometry listeners but no content-change callback.
fix_direction: Connect the long-press recognizer to selectable text (same root as text-007), and add a selection-change callback that receives the selected content.
limitations: The harness uses touch for both sides. Mouse drag selection needs a mouse-down harness method, which does not exist (see text.md harness requests).
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

title: EditableText has no onEditingComplete callback
incular_ref: crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/descriptors.rs:912 (on_submit only); rg for editing_complete finds nothing in crates/incular-widgets/src
evidence: Scenario text__editable_enter_callback_order: onChanged counts match (1 each). The Enter key sent through the test harness does not call Flutter onSubmitted or onEditingComplete (Flutter submits through the IME action, which the test does not send), while Incular's Enter key calls on_submit once. onEditingComplete has no counterpart, so its count is recorded only on the Flutter side.
impact: Apps cannot run completion logic (for example, focus-next or validation) through onEditingComplete, and the Enter-key submit semantics differ between frameworks.
cause: EditableText exposes only on_submit; there is no completion callback and no IME action event in InputEvent.
fix_direction: Add onEditingComplete, call it before onSubmitted on the action path, and decide whether a desktop Enter key should submit (Flutter's key path does not).
limitations: The submitted counter difference mixes an input-path difference (IME action versus key) with a callback difference. Only the missing onEditingComplete is a confirmed gap.
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

cause: Unverified. Incular's caret_reset on focus appears to hide the caret for the first frame, and the phase is offset by one frame at the on/off edges.
evidence: Over 75 frames (about 1.2 s) after a center tap on a collapsed caret, Flutter showCursor is on from t=0 and turns off at 528 ms and on at 1024 ms. Incular is off at t=0 and 16 ms, on from 32 ms, off at 512 ms and on at 1008 ms. Both use a 500 ms half-period; the first-frame state and the edges differ by one frame.
fix_direction: Make caret_reset on focus set the visible phase at the focus instant so the first frame is shown, matching Flutter's restartBlink.
impact: A one-frame delay in the first visible caret after focus. Blink period matches, so steady-state blinking is unaffected.
limitations: Frame quantization is 16 ms; the recorder samples caret_visible, not paint opacity. Not checked on the Flutter side beyond showCursor.

cause: Unknown. Flutter may not record the first edit in UndoHistory from a bare EditableText with DefaultTextEditingShortcuts; the twin was not checked against a MaterialApp shortcut setup.
evidence: Caret moved with End (no programmatic selection), backspace removed the last character (length 3 to 2), 600 ms pumps flush the throttle, then ctrl+z. Flutter stays at length 2 after ctrl+z and after ctrl+shift+z; Incular restores length 3 at 680 ms. The same divergence appears in text__editable_undo_redo, so the programmatic selection set in that scenario is not the cause.
fix_direction: Determine which edit Flutter records in UndoHistory for this sequence, then match Incular's undo grouping. Do not change the Incular behavior until the Flutter cause is confirmed.
impact: Users pressing undo after a deletion get different text in Incular than in Flutter.
limitations: Cause not determined. Twin uses DefaultTextEditingShortcuts with Android shortcuts; a MaterialApp context was not used. Throttle timing was ruled out by the 600 ms settle.
title: Undo does not restore a backspace in a bare EditableText; Incular restores it
verification_note: Not accepted: in the harness Flutter does not restore text on ctrl+z (text_length 2 vs 3 at 680 ms in both undo twins), which contradicts Flutter UndoHistory behavior in real apps. The twins are therefore not shown to be equivalent (likely an UndoHistory activation or key-routing difference in flutter test). Kept as an open question in SUMMARY.md.

cause: Flutter leaves the selection invalid until focus or an explicit set; Incular places it at the end when text is set.
evidence: Before any tap, Flutter selection base and extent are -1 for a controller created with text 'abc' + newline text; Incular reports 12 (end of text). After the tap both sides report identical offsets (9, 1, 5, 12, 5, 12, 0) from frame 2 onward.
fix_direction: Decide whether an unfocused controller should report an invalid selection; if matching Flutter, keep the selection invalid until focus.
impact: Code that reads selection before a field is focused sees different values.
limitations: Only the pre-focus frames differ; after focus the twin matches. Not checked for controllers created without initial text.
title: Controller selection before first focus: Flutter is invalid (-1), Incular is collapsed at text end
verification_note: Duplicate of text-005: the multiline twin differs only in the pre-focus selection (frames 0-1); vertical and document movement match from frame 2.
